headline: QA Morning Signal — 2026-10-10: agentic test tooling, observability, and safer local agents

top_signal.title: Playwright v1.64 adds WebMCP hooks and test-runner quality features
top_signal.summary: Playwright v1.64 introduces page.webmcp and frame.webmcp to call page-registered tools (experimental WebMCP), plus test-runner improvements (shuffle, locks, video options) that help reproduce and surface cross-browser test behavior.
top_signal.why_it_matters: WebMCP gives QA direct APIs to exercise in-page agent tools and validate agent–app interactions; runner changes help find order-dependent flakiness and reproduce test runs reliably.

items.title: GitHub Copilot: local sandboxing now generally available
items.summary: GitHub Copilot added local sandboxing (GA) to constrain agent-run commands: file/directory limits, network access controls, credential restrictions, and enterprise policies to enforce sandboxing for local tools and MCPs.
items.why_it_matters: Sandboxing reduces risk when using Copilot-driven test-generation or execution on developer machines and CI, enabling safer agent-assisted test runs and reproducible test harnesses.

items.title: GitHub Copilot CLI: discover and use local models from the CLI
items.summary: Copilot CLI gained a /model discovery feature to list and choose local models without leaving the CLI workflow, easing selection of on‑device models for local agent use.
items.why_it_matters: Running local models helps QA teams evaluate agentic test tools offline, avoid data exfiltration, and benchmark agent behavior against production test harnesses under controlled conditions.

items.title: JetBrains Marketplace adds UI freeze reports for plugin authors
items.summary: JetBrains Marketplace now provides UI freeze reports (user-submitted) to plugin authors, including thread dumps and context to reproduce IDE freezes that previously could not be diagnosed from reports alone.
items.why_it_matters: Freeze reports give QA and plugin testers concrete diagnostics to reproduce, triage, and write regression tests for UI responsiveness issues in IDE plugins and developer tooling.

items.title: Sentry JavaScript SDK v11 adds tracing across JS platforms (Workers, Bun, Deno)
items.summary: Sentry v11 expands tracing via a code-transformer approach to support Cloudflare Workers, Bun, Deno and other JS runtimes, enabling end-to-end traces where OpenTelemetry integrations were limited.
items.why_it_matters: Broader JS tracing improves QA’s ability to correlate test failures with runtime traces across serverless and edge environments, speeding root-cause analysis and flaky‑test investigation.

items.title: Cloudflare Workers: on-demand CPU and memory profiling with flamegraphs
items.summary: Cloudflare launched on-demand CPU and memory profiling for Workers and Durable Objects, producing interactive flamegraphs in production to identify bottlenecks and memory leaks quickly.
items.why_it_matters: QA and performance engineers can now capture production flamegraphs for serverless code under test, enabling targeted performance tests and faster diagnosis of load-related failures.

items.title: CodeQL 2.27.2: improved analysis for C++, Go, Rust and JavaScript
items.summary: CodeQL 2.27.2 adds a C++ regular-expression parser and language-specific analysis improvements that increase detection coverage for common bug classes across multiple languages.
items.why_it_matters: Upgraded CodeQL rules reduce false negatives in SAST pipelines used by QA and security teams, improving pre-merge quality gates and earlier detection of code paths that cause test failures.

watch.title: Mellum2.1: fast open model built for coding agents and repository-level tool use
watch.summary: JetBrains released Mellum2.1: a compact model trained with large-scale RL in sandboxed runs that can explore repositories, edit files, and check its own changes — optimized for local coding agents and sub-agents.
watch.why_it_matters: If adopted by QA tooling, Mellum2.1 could enable more capable self-driving test agents; monitor for reproducibility, test-harness safety, and deterministic evaluation methods.

learning.title: Validate AI Factory Changes with Digital Twins and AI Agents (practical validation guidance)
learning.summary: NVIDIA outlines using digital twins and agentic harnesses to validate complex AI-factory changes — simulating infra, schedulers, and orchestration to test deployment and performance impacts before production rollouts.
learning.why_it_matters: QA teams testing ML/AI pipelines can use these patterns to design reproducible validation suites, reduce risky live changes, and build evidence for model and infra rollbacks.
